contentBody.description: Understand the customer's AI initative and goals. Define the customers future state & what is the driving need for change. Identify the customer's workload

sections.content:
The first step of the ADDS methodology is Assess. Here are some questions to frame your initial approach with your customer to determine what a Gen AI engagement might entail.

Assess the opportunity with more general AI questions like the below to understand customer goals and objectives:

  • What opportunities or business challenges do they face?
  • What AI analytics like machine learning or computer vision or natural language have they implemented before?
  • Do they want to build it themselves or buy an AI application?
  • Are they interested in LLM/GenAI? What use case? Customer service, summarization or other?
  • Are they using large AI applications requiring heavy duty training or iterative training of model(s)?
  • Are they wanting to improve customer service (like a chat interface)? Or is the GenAI application for product recommendation and upsell to a customer?
  • Is an LLM needed for internal use like summarizing their enterprise data, LLM assistant to their workforce?
  • Have they used tools like Chat GPT?
sections.keyConcept: Leading questions for the Assess phase (more general AI)

sections.content:
Familiarize yourself with and ask the below questions while starting to think about which of our Intel technologies would be the best product for this use case and customer.

  1. Discuss our enterprise strength in Intel Xeon and Core Processors. Most AI Inference has deployed on a CPU. Assess with questions of what opportunities or business challenges do they face?
  2. Are they interest in LLM / Gen AI? What use case? Customer service, summarization or other? Are they using large AI applications requiring heavy duty training or iterative training of model(s)? Gaudi can be a great performant in Deep Learning and Generative AI applications
  3. Identify Visual Computing Workloads: Media streaming / Transcoding and Media Analytics / AI Inference at your customer. Flex GPU is competitive and could be a better price and TCO over competition

Link to detailed ADDS AI COE Primer: https://intel.seismic.com/Link/Content/DC9fBCGP2fgDmGMW76JBGphfcF98
